description: M/of Education - Degree Awarding Institute Order Nagananda International Institute for Buddhist Studies (Pvt) Limited
categorisation: This gazette contains a legal/regulatory order made under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, amending degree recognition conditions and entry qualifications for a specific educational institute. It involves statutory powers, regulatory amendments to existing orders, and compliance requirements for educational standards, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
